rows.en: After the last E2 was confirmed destroyed, I parted ways with the Ra Cailum.
It all began with this weapon, created by the former UCE.
Through the fabricated refugee ship incident, Relena Peacecraft was removed from office, and
the hardliners who inherit the will of Dermail, the root of the war, have seized power again.
They have laid all the blame on Londo Bell’s Ra Cailum, and with that as their pretext, they mean to pull the trigger of war once more.
Will the Ra Cailum, home on Earth with its mission done, let that pass?
The aces will surely fight on to the end to snuff out the new flames of war.
In their place, I leave here every record I have obtained, so that the truth may reach as many as possible.

— Unified Earth Calendar 045, January
From a record disc found at the L1 point —
